input.query: SELECT date_trunc('month', decision_date)::DATE AS month, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions),0) AS approval_rate, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE lower(platform)='android' AND lower(doc_type) IN ('national_id','national id') AND decision_date >= DATE '2025-08-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
